payload.title: lint warns on weak pre-registration fields
payload.body:
Port minsky's experiment-validate lints as non-blocking warnings.
- **Hypothesis**: weak pre-registration (no command, Pivot equal to Success, no source) drops to 0 new cases once the lint warns.
- **Measurement**: `npx tasks-lint --require-prereg TASKS.md` prints WARN lines for weak blocks.
- **Success**: unit tests cover all 3 warnings and pass in CI.
- **Pivot**: warnings fire on more than 20% of well-formed blocks (false positives).
- **Anchor**: Munafò et al. 2017, pre-registration manifesto.
